coordinator_action: Review and freeze target shapes before any active serializer or grammar change. This file does not authorize admission or alter shared grammar.

cross_audit_findings.finding:
A previous draft assigned R_T

B_p and a CHARGED LOCAL_DROP. This is impossible: 4K_T=pR_T+1 and M|K_T imply M<=K_T<=B_p when R_TB_p the first charged rank coordinate rises from 0 to a positive value.
cross_audit_findings.resolution: Replace the shape with TYPEI/ABSORB for M<=B_p and pay CHARGED->ABSORB by PHASE_DROP. Reserve CHARGED overflow/local-drop for M>B_p, which then necessarily has R_T>p.

No new mark is proposed by this track
